comment: Per-component bundle size budgets for @helixui/library (gzipped bytes). Changes require code review.

hx-color-picker.reason: Full color math library (HSV/RGB/HSL conversions), pointer-drag, 4 output formats. JS-only baseline: ~4057 gz.

hx-combobox.reason: Full ARIA combobox, multiple selection with chips, keyboard nav, filtering with debounce, ElementInternals form association. JS-only: ~4083 gz.

hx-date-picker.reason: Calendar grid rendering, full keyboard nav, focus trap, date utilities, ElementInternals form association. JS-only: ~4324 gz.

hx-select.reason: ARIA listbox, keyboard nav, multiple selection, ElementInternals form association, floating-ui positioning. JS-only: ~5.18 KB gz.

hx-time-picker.reason: Time parsing/validation, meridiem toggle, keyboard nav, ElementInternals form association. JS-only: ~5.01 KB gz.
